stem: Two rooms have matched average PPFD and photoperiod, so their calculated DLI is the same. One room uses a substantially different spectral distribution. Which statement is most accurate?
choices: Equal DLI proves the spectra are biologically equivalent
The photon dose is similar, but spectrum remains an independent light characteristic that can influence plant responses
Spectrum is determined entirely by photoperiod
PPFD measures only electrical power, so no comparison is possible
rationale: PPFD and DLI describe photon quantity over a defined waveband and time, but they do not make different spectral distributions biologically identical.
